messages:
oliver: dropped a prototype for shareable compare links + team pins: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/catalog-shareable-compare
jin: nice. two quick things: when a user creates a shareable compare, do pinned versions in that link follow the creator's pins or the viewer's? we should define expected behavior
meera: UX opinion: make the share link snapshot the pinned state (read-only pins) and surface a "Save to my pins" CTA for viewers to adopt. reduces surprise and keeps compare reproducible
jin: agree. also add a small badge on the shared view "Snapshot by <name>" with timestamp and an option to fork into personal compare
oliver: good. interaction note: allow batch pinning from the compare UI (select 3 rows > Pin selected). currently pinning is per-row and slow
meera: batch pin modal should confirm and show resulting pinned strip. provide keyboard support and make it aria-modal with focus trap
qa-bot: Check: ensure pin/unpin actions are idempotent under rapid clicks and that batch pin emits single API call with deduping
jin: accessibility: coachmarks for first-time users should be dismissible and not block keyboard. aria-describedby for each coach element and a "Do not show again" preference stored per-user
meera: microcopy: replace "Pin for follow-up" with "Keep visible in compare". shorter alt: "Keep in compare". Also the toast after pinning should read "2 versions pinned. View pinned versions" and include keyboard focus to the view button
oliver: visual: when many badges are shown, the header legend becomes crowded. propose condensed legend with expandable details per-badge. legend should include source and last-updated time
jin: metric labels: prefer "Median latency (ms)" and "P99 latency (ms)" over shorthand. makes copy clearer for demos
meera: on mobile, pinned strip becomes a collapsible tray at bottom. ensure it doesn't conflict with OS gestures; test on iOS Safari
qa-bot: Added test cases: shareable compare preserves pinned snapshot, batch pin API debounces, coachmarks dismiss persist, pinned strip accessible via keyboard and announced via aria-live
ux-bot: Added UX checklist: share snapshot badge, batch pin flow, coachmark accessibility, legend compact/expand, pinned strip mobile tray
oliver: thanks all. next: jin to wire up fork/save flow, meera to mock batch-pin modal + mobile tray, i'll add copy updates to the component tokens and open a small PR for batch pin endpoint :thumbsup:
